about_the_game:
Galleria
Build. Curate. Profit.

Galleria is your charming little art gallery simulator that nestles comfortably at the bottom of your screen, keeping you company while you work or study. In this cozy desktop companion, you can hire talented artists, commission beautiful paintings, and build a thriving gallery business - all without interrupting your daily workflow. Perfect for office workers and students, Galleria runs quietly in a compact window that you can position anywhere on your desktop. Take quick breaks to check on your artists' progress, collect earnings from sold paintings, and gradually expand your gallery as you go about your day.

🖼️ Gameplay Features:

  • Collect Artists Through Gacha Discover artists through an exciting gacha system featuring five rarity tiers - from Common beginners to Legendary masters! Each rarity brings unique painting speeds and specialties. Assign artists to workstations and keep them productive with food and rest.

  • 50+ Artworks & Visitors Commission over 50 different painting types and welcome 50+ unique visitor types to your gallery. Each artwork has its own completion time and selling price, while visitors bring different spending habits and preferences.

  • Customize Your Gallery Visit the shop to personalize your space with floors, walls, doors, picture frames, and furniture. Create your perfect art sanctuary that reflects your style and attracts more customers.

Whether you're a lover of art or a fan of relaxing tycoon games, Galleria invites you to create a space that celebrates creativity—and makes a tidy profit doing it.

short_description: Become the mastermind behind a growing art empire! In Galleria, you're in charge of a cozy little gallery with big dreams. Buy and exhibit beautiful artworks, attract diverse visitors, and turn your humble space into the most renowned gallery in town.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
